content.value: In the following figure, some desired packet transfer is shown. Introduce a retransmission (12) timer and then calculate and show Retransmission Timeout time (RTO) where applicable. Let, the initial RTO = 6 s.

Recall that, RTO = RTTs + 4RTTD, where $\mathrm { R T T _ { D } = ( 1 { - } \beta ) \mathrm { R T T _ { D } + \beta \lvert \mathrm { R T T _ { s } - \mathrm { R T T _ { M } \lvert \Omega \rvert } } } }$ . Let, the value of α to calculate RTTs is 0.125 and β is 0.25.
